route.source: Source sends a group telegram with HC {{hc}}.
route.receiver: Telegram present on this segment with HC {{hc}}. End devices do not forward it; a linked receiver may accept it even at HC 0.
route.zero: Not forwarded: incoming HC is 0. Devices on the incoming segment can still receive it.
route.filter: Not forwarded: destination group address is absent from this coupler’s filter table.
route.repeater: Repeater has no group-address filter; forwarded with HC {{before}} → {{after}}.
route.forward: Group-address filter permits this route; forwarded with HC {{before}} → {{after}}.
